entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.10 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed subagents losing the task their parent agent gave them, and the parent's ID, after their context was compacted; a subagent's summary now keeps the parent's 10 most recent messages
  • CHG /context (card-slash-core) — noted the after-compaction size shown here and in the compaction marker now also counting what the summary carries into the next prompt, so it is closer to the real size
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — capped attached images at 2000 pixels per side and converted large PNGs to JPEG to stop requests being rejected for exceeding the model's size limit, and fixed an image saved as JPEG but labeled PNG being rejected for a mismatched type
  • FIX /browser <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed this subagent not receiving a page's snapshot when the selected page belongs to an isolated browser context, such as one opened with isolatedContext

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.9 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD Ctrl+V (card-keys) — added native terminal paste shortcut and drag-and-drop image attachment, including over SSH with X11 or Wayland forwarding
  • CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Discover tab now grouping marketplace plugins into sections instead of one flat list
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate warning on non-kebab-case plugin names and checking a plugin's logo and context provider iconUri paths
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the position indicator under long lists now saying what it counts, such as [1-44 of 195 files]
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted the sandbox-escape review now skipping git status in folders that aren't repositories
  • CHG /permissions (card-slash-core) — noted execute_url approvals now per-origin for sensitive Google apps such as mail.google.com, instead of being covered by approving a general Google site
  • FIX /permissions (card-slash-core) — fixed "Always allow" rules for multi-line commands, such as a python -c script spanning several lines, never taking effect
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — fixed Vim mode's r, f, F, t, and T canceling when the target character is a space, and a half-typed operator carrying over after submitting a prompt
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — fixed conversations failing every later model request with INVALID_MEDIA after the agent viewed a corrupt or malformed image
  • FIX /browser <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed this subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot with Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11 and later

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.8 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /diff (card-slash-tools) — added [/] turn-jump shortcuts in Per Turn, progressive background loading for large repositories and long conversations, and sized listings for large or binary untracked files
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted the sandbox-escape review getting more time to decide and stopping any single slow check after 10 seconds
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted expanded install output naming every installed component, and validate checking a plugin's author, homepage, and repository fields
  • CHG /resume / /switch / /conversation (card-slash-core) — noted resuming a conversation now using about 10% less CPU
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed subagents failing to run when their custom agent's name contains a colon, and fixed deleting a conversation leaving its running subagents and workspaces behind instead of cleaning them up
  • FIX Ctrl+V (card-keys) — fixed pasting images on Windows when copied from a browser, Snipping Tool, or another app that puts PNG or V5 bitmap data on the clipboard

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.7 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD hooks.json (card-hooks) — added lastUserInput to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin
  • CHG /help (card-slash-core) — noted the shortcuts tab leaving out basic navigation keys so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find
  • CHG /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted on-demand MCP tools now returning inline results up to 10 KB, previously 4 KB
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode asking for approval less often on routine commands such as cleanup and formatting
  • CHG colorScheme (card-settings) — noted the default Terminal scheme now using box-drawing table borders in Markdown, matching the other color schemes
  • FIX /compact [message] (card-slash-core) — fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — fixed Vim mode's r replace leaving part of a collapsed pasted-text placeholder behind
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed plugin and MCP sign-ins not saving when the token was too large for the system keychain, and an OAuth token being shared across or left behind for different users of the same computer account

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.6 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — added a Configure MCP servers... action for installed plugins to set or change MCP server variables without disabling and re-enabling the plugin
  • CHG --sandbox (card-cli) — noted sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify ~/.docker, ~/.kube, or ~/_netrc without an explicit grant
  • CHG /compact [message] (card-slash-core) — noted compaction now keeping images, PDFs, and other attached files in the conversation summary
  • CHG /statusline (card-slash-core) — noted the in-progress status line now showing what the agent is waiting on, such as a retrying model, instead of a generic working label
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate expanded to check a plugin's context providers and skills entries in plugin.json
  • FIX Esc (card-keys) — fixed the Esc disabled during file edits warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.5 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG Ctrl+O (card-keys) — noted collapsed thought blocks now showing only their Thought for … header, separated from the response by a blank line
  • CHG /schedule <when> <task> (card-slash-tools) — noted recurring schedules now firing at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted folded-line match counts in / search, a consistent cursor style in Commit Tree, and Per Turn starting on the first file
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — fixed plugins failing to load when plugin.json gives skills as a single path string instead of an array, and marketplace installs failing on a briefly stale or interrupted download

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.4 — 14 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode now available on Windows 11 24H2+ for personal Google Accounts, and its sandbox-escape review getting faster, considering the preceding question on short replies like yes, checking every subcommand in a pipeline, and prompting before destructive Git or file commands
  • CHG Shift+Tab (card-keys) — noted it now also cycles into Auto mode on Windows 11 24H2+, matching --mode auto
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the whole-file toggle (f) and hunk folding (Ctrl+O) extended to the Commit Tree view, Per Turn diffs combining multiple edits to one file, and the fix for long rows wrapping instead of truncating and Per Turn headers truncating prompts at 50 characters
  • CHG mcp_config.json (card-hooks) — noted _meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"] now sent on MCP tools/call requests so servers see the top-level conversation ID from nested subagents
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate getting stricter checks across plugin.json, MCP configs, hooks.json, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON, unknown fields, bad placeholders, unrecognized hook matchers, and missing hook scripts
  • CHG /compact [message] (card-slash-core) — noted automatic and on-demand compaction now keeping tool declarations so the model API can reuse its cached prompt prefix
  • CHG agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted the multi-pane touch layout for tablets/foldables, scrollbar popovers staying open while dragged, and fixes for clipped phone dialogs, iOS Safari input zoom, reverting telemetry/marketing settings, dropped drag-URL query parameters, broken nested code blocks, $VAR parsed as LaTeX, blurry Copy Image/Export as PDF, and background-tab timer drift
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and plugin-bundled subagents with restricted MCP tools failing to start
  • FIX .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for rules and skills loading twice when found in both a standalone folder and an enabled plugin
  • FIX verbosity (card-settings) — noted the fix for the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, and blank gaps above the prompt in Medium verbosity
  • FIX Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (card-keys) — noted the fix for mishandled pasted text, merged history entries, no-op undo steps, and characters truncated near emoji
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking on a failed tools/list or shutdown mid-connect
  • FIX ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md (card-skills) — noted the system-prompt wording fix so GEMINI.md/AGENTS.md rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions too, not just later ones
  • FIX Ctrl+V (card-keys) — noted the fix for parameterized MIME types such as audio/webm; codecs=opus being rejected as unsupported

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.3 — 11 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the new / search across the file list and file view, with match highlighting, a match-count prompt, and n/N stepping through matches
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted n/N in this viewer now also stepping through matches one at a time, including several on the same line
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate expanded to check a plugin's hooks, sidecars, and component manifests, and install/import now following NO_COLOR/CLICOLOR/CLICOLOR_FORCE like validate already did
  • CHG /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted timer durations now shown in human-readable units, such as 1d 2h timer, instead of raw seconds
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted subagents and custom agents in Auto mode no longer asking approval for every sandbox-escaping command; a separate agent reviews them like the main agent's
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the CLI no longer offering sandboxed options on systems where the sandbox can't run, such as Linux systems blocking unprivileged user namespaces and Windows before 11 24H2
  • FIX GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted the fix for Gemini 4 Argon not appearing in /model and --model when connected with this key
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent losing track of its most recently started subagents after a conversation was compacted
  • FIX PostToolUse (card-hooks) — noted a failing hook no longer marking a successful tool call as failed; the failure is now logged separately
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for updating or reinstalling a marketplace plugin on Windows leaving it half-deleted while another session or app had it open
  • FIX agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted Remote Control on iPhone/iPad no longer re-prompting the Security Notice and Enable Notifications dialogs every time; it now remembers those answers along with theme, layout, and dismissed tips

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.2 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • FIX agy remote-control (card-cli) — fixed conversation history not appearing in Remote Control when running in daemon mode

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.1 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate expanded to check a plugin's skills, subagents, and rules
  • CHG colorScheme (card-settings) — noted the inline diff preview shown for proposed file edits now getting syntax highlighting and background tints under the Terminal color scheme
  • CHG enableTelemetry (card-settings) — noted this now shown as off (disabled) with an explanation for Business accounts, including Application Default Credentials sign-in
  • CHG AGY_ADC_AUTH (card-env) — noted first-run setup under this sign-in method now showing the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service without the consumer telemetry opt-in checkbox
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted Windows versions that don't support the terminal sandbox now falling back to asking before running commands instead of failing to start, when a sandboxed permission mode was selected
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted an MCP server that exits unexpectedly is now marked Error and its closed session removed, instead of staying shown as Ready
  • FIX /title (card-slash-core) and /remote-control (card-slash-tools) — noted both now accepting on/off typed in any case

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.0 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD AGY_CLI_OSC7501 / AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES (card-env) — two new unverified rows for OSC 7501 terminal status reporting (tab/window shows working/waiting/done/failed) and its brief message mode, named only in this release
  • ADD Alt+M (card-keys) — new unverified row for sending using the opposite of your Queued Messages setting, named only in this release
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate rewritten to check a plugin with the CLI's own loading rules, listing errors/warnings by file and line, plus the new --strict and --json flags
  • FIX /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the Commit Tree view counting commits instead of lines, restricting the cursor to commit rows with Enter opening them, filling the terminal height, and showing the latest 100 commits (previously 10) with scrolling
  • FIX mcp_config.json (card-hooks) — noted the fix for plugin MCP servers using a header variable, such as a bearer token, sending the literal placeholder instead of the configured value
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent losing track of file changes, tasks, and session cost when a background command finished while it kept working, and for a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — noted the fix for every message failing with Eligibility check failed after a brief service outage or rate limit at launch, requiring a restart

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.6 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD AGY_ADC_AUTH (card-env) — new unverified row for Application Default Credentials sign-in, named in this release (Claude Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5 availability) and in 1.3.3; absent from any docs page in sources.json
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode's sandbox-escape review getting faster, allowing the workspace's own format/lint/fix commands, and blocking sensitive-data uploads
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the Commit Tree view's colorization (hashes, change IDs, dimmed descriptions, highlighted working-copy row, bold @)
  • CHG /model (card-slash-core) — noted Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 becoming available via ADC sign-in, gated by Google Cloud project access
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for lost subagent/workflow-agent questions, now surfaced as an <agent> has a question alert with a Ctrl+K/a picker, skipped in headless -p runs
  • FIX .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for skills/rules/workflows/Markdown agents failing to load when an unquoted description: contains a colon
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the Mermaid frontmatter/%%{init}%%/v11-syntax rendering fix, and the / search highlight/crash fix for lowercase-length-changing characters such as İ
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted the fix for a case-sensitive Plugin.json manifest not being found by install/validate/enable/disable
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for /plugin subcommands such as /plugin List failing on non-lowercase input
  • ADD Re-extracted the slash command inventory from cli/reference and added five newly-documented commands
    • /browser <task>, /goal <objective>, and /learn [instruction] (card-slash-tools, Tools & tasks/Reasoning), and /schedule <when> <task> and /changelog (card-slash-tools) are confirmed on the current core slash command table. /browser, /goal, /learn, and /schedule were explicitly removed as phantom commands from the first draft (v1.2.2) for not existing on that table at the time; they're real now.

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.5 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD auto value on --mode <mode> (card-cli) — unverified Auto mode: autonomous approval of file edits and safe commands with sandbox-escape review by a separate agent; Linux/macOS only; absent from any agy --help this card was verified against
  • ADD Shift+Tab (card-keys) — new unverified row for cycling agent execution modes, absent from the cli/reference keybinding tables
  • CHG /config (card-slash-core) — noted the new Agent Mode entry for picking accept-edits/plan/auto
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted syntax highlighting, code folding (Ctrl+O, f), and row virtualization for very large files
  • FIX colorScheme (card-settings) — noted the fix for colors dropping to 256 in iTerm2 over SSH where COLORTERM isn't forwarded

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.4 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD agy plugin list (card-hooks) — noted the new --json flag and the fix for listing only imported plugins instead of every installed plugin
  • CHG /model (card-slash-core) — noted the picker hiding third-party models a Business/GCP project can't access, instead of failing on send
  • CHG agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted the browser Settings modal now mirroring real CLI settings, and serve sessions reading/saving settings.json
  • FIX --agent <name> (card-cli) — noted the fix for an unknown agent name silently running the default agent instead of erroring or warning
  • FIX -p (card-cli) — noted --print combined with --prompt-interactive now exiting with status 2 instead of 0
  • FIX /resume (card-slash-core) — noted the @conversation: suggestion fallback after a 2-second stall
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted OAuth sign-outs now happening only on an actual rejection, not a transient network/timeout/server error
  • FIX /permissions (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for Remote Control "Always allow" rules outliving their removal in the browser or this panel
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for a truncated or header-only WebM file being rejected on read instead of breaking every later request
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for plugin details leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root agents.json

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.3 — 13 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD _meta: {"antigravity/alwaysLoad": true} (card-hooks) — new unverified row: an MCP server can mark a tool as always loaded in its tools/list response; absent from docs/mcp
  • CHG altScreenMode (card-settings) — noted the pinned prompt header while scrolling back through a long conversation in no-flicker mode
  • CHG plugins/<name>/plugin.json (card-hooks) — noted a root-level agents.json for a plugin's own subagents, per the release notes only
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the macOS sandbox blocking ~/Library/Application Support reads by default, and the Windows PowerShell 7 (Microsoft Store) fallback fix
  • CHG /usage (card-slash-tools) — noted individual quota being reported immediately instead of retried first
  • CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Installed tab's improved search (spaces, Enter, Space to toggle)
  • FIX /add-dir (card-slash-tools) — noted the clearer directory not found/not a directory errors
  • FIX /btw (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix stopping side questions from running user/workspace hooks
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the multi-repo subagent workspace isolation fix and the fix clearing a stopped subagent's pending approval right away
  • FIX --remote-control (card-cli) and /remote-control (card-slash-tools) — noted both being disabled under ADC sign-in, which isn't supported yet, instead of failing unclearly
  • FIX /keybindings (card-slash-core) — noted the macOS Option-key alt keybinding fix and the clear error when the configured editor can't be found
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted the skills.json-exclusion and import-race fixes for validate and plugin listings
  • FIX /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the color.ui = always fix and the real-cause fix when the fallback git diff also fails

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.2 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted this manager opening onto the official plugin marketplace, with agy plugin install <name>@antigravity-plugins-official and local-directory installs, plus install reliability improvements
  • CHG plugins/<name>/plugin.json (card-hooks) — noted the .antigravity-plugin//.gemini-plugin/ manifest folder, skills field, PLUGIN_DATA, and bin/ folder, per the release notes only
  • CHG --dangerously-skip-permissions (card-cli) — noted this no longer auto-approving the implementation plan in planning mode; it only skips tool permission prompts now
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted images now scaled to at most 2576px per side (previously 4096) to stay within Claude models' limits
  • FIX /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the Commit Tree Tab/arrow-key fix and the new Shift+Tab previous-view shortcut
  • FIX /resume (card-slash-core) — noted the Other-tab import crash fix and the CJK conversation-title truncation fix

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.1 — 9 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the improved cross-file navigation (←/→ jump to the next file's first change, per-file cursor/scroll memory, n/N continuing across files) and the new change A/B · file X/Y header position indicator
  • FIX /rewind (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for very long conversations listing space-compacted messages as (empty message) and erroring when selected
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Windows MCP-server lifecycle fix for install/reinstall/uninstall, UTF-8 BOM support for plugin and MCP/hook config files, and the marketplace-install overwrite fix
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for relative skills:/plugins:/rules:/agents:/hooks: paths in Markdown custom agents, and subagents stuck on an error now showing Error: instead of Done
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted that timers, recurring jobs, and other background tools now appear here too, not just background shell commands
  • FIX queuedMessages (card-settings) — noted the fix for "send-immediately" messages being silently queued whenever the agent had written or updated an artifact during the turn
  • FIX notifications (card-settings) — noted that it now alerts for pending questions, not just tool permission prompts
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for a server restart sometimes leaving it stopped with a "Failed to stop existing instances for reload" error
  • FIX GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that a dropped connection to the Gemini API now retries instead of failing the turn as cancelled

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.0 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG verbosity (card-settings) — noted the default changing from high to medium, per the release notes only; cli/reference still documents the old default and values
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted j/k now moving the line cursor like the arrow keys instead of jumping between files

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.17 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD Esc (card-keys) — noted the new dismissible announcement cards for model launches and service notices, dismissed permanently with Esc on an empty prompt
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the Windows sandbox no longer needing administrator rights, with Python/Git/npm working out of the box
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for .tiff images being misreported and silently converted to PNG

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.16 — 9 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /config (card-slash-core) — noted the ←/→ shortcut to cycle a highlighted setting's value without opening the dropdown
  • ADD /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted image-generation requests now running as a built-in image-generator subagent
  • CHG altScreenMode (card-settings) — noted improved resize performance in no-flicker (altscreen) mode for long conversations
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted improved mouse text selection with auto-scroll and streaming-safe selection, in both the altscreen view and this viewer
  • CHG queuedMessages (card-settings) — noted the fix so "send-immediately" messages sent while others are queued go out together, in order, instead of joining the queue
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent stalling after a background command crashed or was killed, and for headless -p runs exiting too early
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — noted the fix for k in Vim Normal mode recalling command history instead of queued messages
  • FIX .agents/rules/*.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for manifests in a parent .agents/ directory being ignored when a session started in a subdirectory
  • FIX /skills (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the / menu listing skills the current agent does not enable
